# Real Project What-if Diff Scenarios

These directories are generated from the live Project t0 snapshot. `t0_bom.json` is the real snapshot; `t1_bom.json` is a controlled license mutation with `simulation=true` and a retained original A-level evidence entry.

Run Project and Diff with the explicit files in each scenario; do not treat the mutated t1 as a live ModelScope observation.
